thread:
maya: hi all! totally new here — quick q about where to post a few things: access requests (laptop/okta), onboarding questions, and product feedback. also any bot commands i should run? first week and a bit overwhelmed :grimacing:
ashley: welcome @maya! :wave: For access/IT stuff use #help and ping @it-support. For HR/new hire paperwork ping @people-ops.
it-support-bot: FYI, IT requests are tracked via the help ticketing form: https://redwood.internal/help-request — you can also DM @it-support for urgent device provisioning.
joanna: For product/feature questions use #product. For infra/deployment questions use #eng-infra. If you're unsure post here and we'll steer you.
samir: Bots quick list: we have `/onboard` in #new-hires for checklist stuff and /deploybot in #release-war-room. Try `/onboard status` to see your checklist state.
maya: thanks! do we use threads for cross-posting? e.g., if i post a device issue in #help should i also ping #eng-infra?
ashley: use threads for follow-ups and updates. avoid cross-posting unless it's an outage or impacts multiple teams. if it touches infra, post in #help and mention the other channel once.
dev-rel-bot: Quick tip: to run the onboarding checklist run:
```
/onboard start @maya
/onboard checklist
```
jordan: also — keep non-actionable notes out of #announcements (company-wide). product feedback should go in #product-feedback or the weekly feedback doc.
maya: noted — appreciate all the pointers! one last q: who approves dev tool access? @ashley or someone else?
ashley: i can approve standard dev tool access. for production or sensitive systems ping @security and fill the org-approval form.
maya: :tada: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll kick off the /onboard flow now.
